lessons.title: Practice Dot Product Similarity
lessons.description: Finish dot_product. Calculate dot product between two numerical feature vectors in Python. The test checks that dot_product([1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]) equals 11.0.
lessons.solution_code:
def dot_product(vec_a: list[float], vec_b: list[float]) -> float:
    return sum(a * b for a, b in zip(vec_a, vec_b))

source.name: Dive into Deep Learning §2.3 Linear Algebra — dot product is 'a sum over the products of the elements at the same position'
